### War between the Houses of David and Saul
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/war-between-houses-david-and-saul
Passage: 2 Samuel 2:23
Points:
- Abner resisted God's revealed will by installing Ish-bosheth as king over northern Israel.
- This rebellion ignited a destructive civil clash between the two factions at Gibeon.
- Asahel relentlessly pursued Abner and refused to turn away, suffering a fatal spear thrust.
- Defying God's known purpose leads only to devastation, loss of life, and regret.
- Believers must resist stubborn denial and pray for courage to accept God's truth.

### Anticipate the End
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-dec-30-2010-11643352.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 2:26
Points:
- Abner's warning that conflict ends in bitterness illustrates the fate of superficial religion.
- Attending church out of mere routine leaves a person without true spiritual life.
- Constant exposure to gospel truth can lull an unrepentant heart into dangerous complacency.
- Arriving at life's end without Christ brings agonizing regret and eternal separation from God.
- Readers are urged to examine themselves and possess genuine faith in Jesus.
